output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability is in the mintToken function where the balanceOf target is increased by mintedAmount without a check, allowing the owner to mint unlimited tokens.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability is in the _transfer function where the balanceOf[_to] += _value is executed, allowing the owner to transfer unlimited tokens.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability is in the approve function where the allowance[_owner][_spender] = _value is executed, allowing the owner to approve unlimited tokens.
